name: computer-use-automation
description: Record UI automations once with an LLM, then replay them deterministically as typed capabilities. Tools: list_capabilities, run_capability, discover_capability.

interface.longDescription: Turns a goal into a recorded, typed capability for a web app with no API (discovery uses an LLM once), then replays it deterministically without a model. Replay reports business outcomes, failures with the failing step, and escalations that need a person.
